reference_sql:
WITH user_sessions AS (  -- one row per session of a German user who signed up in July 2025
  SELECT su.user_id, s.session_id, s.utm_source,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.user_id ORDER BY s.session_start, s.session_id) AS rn
  FROM signups su
  JOIN sessions s ON s.visitor_id = su.visitor_id
  WHERE su.country_code = 'DE'
    AND su.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND su.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-08-01 00:00:00+00'
)
SELECT user_id, session_id, utm_source
FROM user_sessions
WHERE rn = 1
alternatives:
SELECT su.user_id, s.session_id, s.utm_source
FROM signups su
JOIN sessions s ON s.visitor_id = su.visitor_id
WHERE su.country_code = 'DE'
  AND su.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND su.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-08-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sessions s2
    WHERE s2.visitor_id = s.visitor_id
      AND (s2.session_start < s.session_start OR (s2.session_start = s.session_start AND s2.session_id < s.session_id))
  )

SELECT t.user_id, t.session_id, t.utm_source
FROM (
  -- one row per session of a German user who signed up in July 2025
  SELECT su.user_id, s.session_id, s.utm_source,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.user_id ORDER BY s.session_start, s.session_id) AS rn
  FROM signups su
  JOIN sessions s ON s.visitor_id = su.visitor_id
  WHERE su.country_code = 'DE'
    AND su.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND su.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-08-01 00:00:00+00'
) AS t
WHERE t.rn = 1

solver.query:
WITH de AS (
  SELECT user_id, visitor_id
  FROM signups
  WHERE country_code = 'DE'
    AND signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-08-01 00:00:00+00'
),
r AS (
  SELECT de.user_id, s.session_id, s.utm_source,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.user_id ORDER BY s.session_start ASC, s.session_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM de
  JOIN sessions s ON s.visitor_id = de.visitor_id
)
SELECT user_id, session_id, utm_source
FROM r
WHERE rn = 1
